title: 第180章 《单车》
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦红蔻边看着后视镜，边操控着红色法拉利倒退向蓝色传送门。

她嘴角轻轻扬起，脸上不仅没有丝毫慌张，反而满脸期待。

红色法拉利直接冲入蓝色传送门里，消失不见。

在副本的终点，有一条红绳一左一右地绑在公路两旁的大树树干上，地面被人用粉笔写着‘终点’两个字。

很简陋的终点...

而且‘终点’这两个字还写得贼难看...

红绳上方，还悬着一面屏幕，背景依旧是红色的狐狸面具。

只不过，这面屏幕内容是不断变化的四个队伍排名：

【第一名：00621，2级载具，粉色爱玛电动车】

【第二名：00520，1级载具，武陵小货车】

【第三名：56547，1级载具，凯迪拉克黑色轿车】

【第四名：01430，3级载具，法拉利SF90Spider敞篷版】

不止是终点有屏幕的排名显示。

赛道每隔1000米，上方就悬浮着一个显示即时排名的屏幕。

这些屏幕的位置偏离了弯道，只会在直道上出现。

突然！一道蓝色传送门在赛道内的红绳前展开。

一台红色法拉利倒着开出传送门。

蓝色传送门直接并拢、消失。

而法拉利车头对着的，正是终点的红绳。

秦红蔻驾驶着红色法拉利完全开出传送门后，终点的排名就发生了变化。

她已经成为了第一名！

秦红蔻看着眼前的红绳，嘴角轻轻扬起：

“果然如此！这就是不破不立吗？！”

她直接一个D挡加赛道模式，脚下油门踩死。

这台700多万的超跑，直接爆发出吓人一跳的轰鸣声！

犹如一头苏醒的野兽！

由于倒车的惯性还在，法拉利车身后退，但后轮却向前飞速滚动，后轮与地面剧烈摩擦，发出一阵刺耳的声音，轮胎也扬起刺鼻的青烟。

等前进的动能超过衰减的惯性后，这头苏醒的红色野兽，猛地窜了出去！

犹如一条红色利箭，直接冲过终点。

由于法拉利的车身太低，并没能撞断红绳。

秦红蔻看都不看，左手探出车外，精准将红绳给扯了下来。

秦红蔻操控着完全苏醒的性能野兽，灵活地避开被摆放在道路中央的木箱子后，她边挥舞着红绳边开心地喊了起来：

“芜湖——！！！”

“爽啊！还是拉法适合姐姐我！”

“不过...还不够快！姐姐喜欢超快的！！！”

“小晨应该就是超快的，毕竟他可是姐姐我亲手调出来的~！所有健身动作都是姐姐我指定的！嘿嘿嘿！”

“虽然有点对不起闺蜜，但她儿子是真姐姐我的心头好！”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Hongkou looked at the rearview mirror and controlled the red Ferrari to reverse toward the blue portal.

The corners of her mouth raised slightly, and her face was not panicked at all, but full of expectation.

The red Ferrari rushed directly into the blue portal and disappeared.

At the end of the copy, there was a red rope tied to the trunks of the big trees on both sides of the road, and the word "end" was written in chalk on the ground.

A very crude end point...

Moreover, the word "end" is written in a very ugly way...

There is a screen hanging above the red rope, and the background is still the red fox mask.

However, the content on this screen is the constantly changing rankings of the four teams:

[First place: 00621, level 2 vehicle, pink Emma electric car]

[Second place: 00520, level 1 vehicle, Wuling pickup truck]

[Third place: 56547, level 1 vehicle, Cadillac black car]

[Fourth place: 01430, level 3 vehicle, Ferrari SF90Spider convertible]

Not only is the ranking displayed on the screen at the end point.

Every 1,000 meters on the track, a screen showing real-time rankings is suspended above.

These screens are positioned away from the curves and only appear on the straights.

Sudden!A blue portal opens in front of the red rope in the track.

A red Ferrari drove out of the portal upside down.

The blue portals came together and disappeared.

The front of the Ferrari is facing the red rope at the end.

After Qin Hongkou drove the red Ferrari completely out of the portal, the ranking at the finish line changed.

She has become number one!

Qin Hongkou looked at the red rope in front of her and raised the corners of her mouth slightly:

"As expected! Isn't this what it means to be neither broken nor established?!"

She directly shifted into D gear and track mode, and stepped on the accelerator.

This supercar costing more than 7 million yuan erupted into a frightening roar!

Like an awakened beast!

Because the inertia of reversing was still there, the Ferrari's body moved backwards, but the rear wheels rolled forward rapidly. The rear wheels rubbed violently with the ground, making a piercing sound, and the tires also raised pungent smoke.

After the forward kinetic energy exceeded the attenuated inertia, the awakened red beast suddenly jumped out!

Like a sharp red arrow, it crossed the finish line directly.

Because the Ferrari's body was too low, it failed to break the red rope.

Without even looking, Qin Hongkou reached out of the car with her left hand and pulled off the red rope with precision.

Qin Hongkou controlled the fully awakened performance beast and nimbly avoided the wooden box placed in the middle of the road. She waved the red rope and shouted happily:

"Wuhu——!!!"

"It's great! Rafa is still suitable for me, my sister!"

"But...it's not fast enough! My sister likes super fast ones!!!"

"Xiaochen should be super fast. After all, he is my sister and I personally adjusted him~! All fitness moves are designated by my sister! Hehehehe!"

"Although I feel a little sorry for my bestie, her son is a real sister and I love her so much!"
